date.as_written: vaiśvānarābdhiśikhare, gate nepāla hāyane phālguṇasya site pakṣe daśamyām ādrayā (!) saha || saubhāgye suraje vāre

notes: The scribe's name is lacunose in the transcript (+ + + + + nāmāsau) but identified as Jīvarāma in the catalogue metadata. The scribe is described genealogically as the son of the younger brother of the middle son of Śrī Rāghava (śrīrāghavatanūjasya madhyamasyānujātmajaḥ). The chronogram vaiśvānara (3) - abdhi (4) - śikhara (7) yields NS 743.
